blocks.prompt: 18 Find the general solution of the differential equation \(x\frac{dy}{dx} - y = \frac{x^4 + x^3y}{y^3 - x^3}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal lamba dikhta hai lekin tareeqa wohi hai. Agar \(y = vx\) rakhein to right side \(x\) times \(v\) ka function ban jati hai aur left side \(x^2\frac{dv}{dx}\).
Is liye equation homogeneous hai aur \(y = vx\) se separable ho jayegi.
Diya kya hai? \(x\frac{dy}{dx} - y = \frac{x^4 + x^3y}{y^3 - x^3}\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\), phir \(v^3 - 1\) ko \(v + 1\) par divide karna (kyunke upar ki degree neeche se zyada hai), phir integrate.
Plan: dono sides alag alag simplify, variables alag, division, integrate, \(v\) wapas, aur \(x^3\) se multiply.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x\frac{dy}{dx} - y = \frac{x^4 + x^3y}{y^3 - x^3}\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation: \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\). (\(x\) se divide karein to \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y}{x} + \frac{1 + y/x}{(y/x)^3 - 1}\), jo sirf \(y/x\) ka function hai.)

Left side mein \(y = vx\)
\[x\left(v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx}\right) - vx = x^2\dfrac{dv}{dx}\]
Kyun: Bracket kholne par \(xv + x^2\frac{dv}{dx}\) aaya, aur \(xv\) aur \(-vx\) aapas mein cancel ho gaye. Is sawal mein yeh hissa khud hi bohat saaf ho jata hai.

Right side mein \(y = vx\)
\[\dfrac{x^4 + x^4v}{x^3v^3 - x^3} = \dfrac{x^4(1 + v)}{x^3(v^3 - 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{x(1 + v)}{v^3 - 1}\]
Kyun: \(x^3y = x^3 \cdot vx = x^4v\) aur \(y^3 = v^3x^3\). Upar se \(x^4\) aur neeche se \(x^3\) common nikala, phir \(x^3\) cancel kiya to ek \(x\) bach gaya.
Dhyan dein: Denominator mein \(y^3 - x^3\) ko \(x^3(v^3 - 1)\) likhna hai, \(x^3(1 - v^3)\) nahi; sign ulta ho gaya to aage poora jawab ulta ho jayega. Isi liye har qadam par sign dobara dekh lena achhi aadat hai.

Dono sides barabar kar ke variables alag karein
\[x^2\dfrac{dv}{dx} = \dfrac{x(1 + v)}{v^3 - 1}\]
\[\dfrac{v^3 - 1}{v + 1}\,dv = \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(x\) se divide kiya, phir \(\frac{v^3 - 1}{v + 1}\) ko \(dv\) ke saath aur \(\frac{1}{x}\) ko \(dx\) ke saath rakha.

\(v^3 - 1\) ko \(v + 1\) par divide karein
\[(v + 1)(v^2 - v + 1) = v^3 + 1\]
\[\dfrac{v^3 - 1}{v + 1} = v^2 - v + 1 - \dfrac{2}{v + 1}\]
Kyun: Numerator ki degree 3 hai aur denominator ki 1, aisi fraction ko seedha integrate nahi kar sakte; pehle divide karna parta hai. Formula \(a^3 + b^3 = (a + b)(a^2 - ab + b^2)\) se \(v^3 + 1\) ke factors maloom hain, aur \(v^3 - 1 = (v^3 + 1) - 2\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan \(-2\) bachta hai, \(-1\) nahi; isi farq ki wajah se is sawal ka jawab key se mukhtalif aata hai (neeche dekhiye).

Integrate karein
\[\dfrac{v^3}{3} - \dfrac{v^2}{2} + v - 2\ln|v + 1|\]
\[= \ln|x| + \ln|C|\]
Kyun: Har power par power rule \(\int v^n\,dv = \frac{v^{n+1}}{n+1}\) lagaya, aur \(\int \frac{dv}{v + 1} = \ln|v + 1|\).

6 se multiply kar ke logs ikatthe karein
\[2v^3 - 3v^2 + 6v\]
\[= 6\ln|x| + 12\ln|v + 1| + 6\ln|C|\]
\[= 6\ln|Cx(v + 1)^2|\]
Kyun: 6 se multiply kiya taa ke 3 aur 2 wale fractions khatam ho jayein. \(-2\ln|v + 1|\) ko right side le gaye to \(+12\ln|v + 1|\) bana, aur \(12\ln|v + 1| = 6\ln(v + 1)^2\). Phir \(\ln a + \ln b + \ln c = \ln abc\).

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein
\[x(v + 1)^2 = \dfrac{(x + y)^2}{x}\]
\[\dfrac{2y^3}{x^3} - \dfrac{3y^2}{x^2} + \dfrac{6y}{x}\]
\[= 6\ln\left|\dfrac{C(x + y)^2}{x}\right|\]
Kyun: \(v + 1 = \frac{y}{x} + 1 = \frac{x + y}{x}\), is liye \((v + 1)^2 = \frac{(x + y)^2}{x^2}\), aur \(x\) se multiply karne par ek \(x\) cancel ho gaya.

\(x^3\) se multiply karein
\[2y^3 - 3xy^2 + 6x^2y\]
\[= 6x^3\ln\left|\dfrac{C(x + y)^2}{x}\right|\]
Kyun: Left side ke saare fractions khatam karne ke liye sab se bara denominator \(x^3\) tha, is liye har term ko \(x^3\) se multiply kiya: \(\frac{2y^3}{x^3}\) se \(2y^3\), \(\frac{3y^2}{x^2}\) se \(3xy^2\) aur \(\frac{6y}{x}\) se \(6x^2y\) bana. Right side par \(x^3\) log ke bahar coefficient ki tarah aa gaya.

Tasdeeq
Integrate ki hui equation ki left side ka derivative \(v^2 - v + 1 - \frac{2}{v + 1}\) hai, jo wohi integrand hai \(\checkmark\). Aakhri jawab ko implicitly differentiate karne par (computer algebra se) wapas \(x\frac{dy}{dx} - y = \frac{x^4 + x^3y}{y^3 - x^3}\) milta hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Dono tasdeeqein batati hain ke chhape hue sawal ka yahi sahi jawab hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (jo 18 ki bajaye number 21 par chhapi hai) \(2y^3 - 3xy^2 + 6x^2y = 6x^3\ln|C(y + x)|\) deti hai. Yeh jawab chhapi hui equation ko satisfy nahi karta. Yeh us equation ka jawab hai jis mein denominator \(y^3 - x^3\) ki bajaye sirf \(y^3\) ho: tab \(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + v}{v^3}\) banta hai, \(\frac{v^3}{v + 1} = v^2 - v + 1 - \frac{1}{v + 1}\), aur integrate karne par \(2v^3 - 3v^2 + 6v = 6\ln|Cx(v + 1)|\) aata hai, jo bilkul key wala jawab hai. Yani ya to sawal ka denominator ghalat chhapa hai ya key ghalat hai. Jo sawal chhapa hai (denominator \(y^3 - x^3\)) us ka sahi jawab woh hai jo upar nikala gaya. (Keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal 25 hain; keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi.)
